name: io.github.YauhenBichel/when-free
title: when-free
description: Which days and times am I free? Reads your calendar feeds and answers with the slots you can offer.

environmentVariables.name: WHENFREE_CALENDARS
environmentVariables.description: Private iCal addresses of your calendars, comma-separated. Optional if you saved them with `whenfree add`.

environmentVariables.name: WHENFREE_TZ
environmentVariables.description: Time zone for answers, like Europe/London. Default: the computer's.
